_comment: OLX Lebanon endpoints, mapped from a capture of the web app (October 2026). Copy to config/endpoints.json. If OLX changes them, recapture (docs/ENDPOINT-CAPTURE.md). path is relative to OLX_BASE_URL or an absolute URL; {id} is the ad's 9-digit externalID. The ad API lives on Dubizzle Group's backend, so those entries set sendSessionToForeignHost: the web app sends its bearer token there itself.
